meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容变成可交互的演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要制作带分支导航和演讲者备注的交互式幻灯片
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create interactive slides with branching and speaker notes

howto.what: 制作 HyperFrames 幻灯片(deck):含离散幻灯片、片段揭示、分支跳转、热点导航、演示者模式与演讲者备注;也能把现有页面转成 deck。产出可交互浏览的 deck,不是视频。
howto.when: 用户明确要求做幻灯片(如 slideshow、slide show、HyperFrames slideshow)时直接执行;若提到“presentation”“pitch deck”“deck”等相邻请求,会先确认再制作;素材来自 Figma 链接时先运行 /figma。

say.text: 帮我做一个产品发布会幻灯片，5页左右
say.note: 会直接开始制作可导航的 deck。

say.text: 把这个落地页转成交互式 deck，保留原有动效
say.note: 会先询问确认，再按源页面保真转换。

say.text: 在第3页加一个热点，点击跳到附录分支
say.note: 会在清单中加入热点与分支序列。

howto.what_en: Builds a HyperFrames slideshow deck (discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspots, presenter mode with speaker notes) or converts an existing page into such a deck. The result is a navigable deck, not an MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers on explicit slideshow requests (e.g. 'slideshow', 'slide show'). For adjacent requests like 'presentation' or 'deck', it confirms first. If Figma URL is given, it runs /figma first.

say_en.text: Make me a 5-slide product launch deck.
say_en.note: Builds the deck directly as a navigable slideshow.

say_en.text: Convert this landing page into an interactive deck, keeping its animations.
say_en.note: Asks for confirmation first, then ports the page faithfully.

say_en.text: Add a hotspot on slide 3 that jumps to the appendix branch.
say_en.note: Adds the hotspot and branch sequence to the slide manifest.
